name: gh-issue-flow
description: Board-driven issue workflow: triage, pick the next issue, plan it, implement it in a worktree, adversarially review the diff, open a PR, and drive it to green.

board_number.title: GitHub Project number
board_number.description: The Projects v2 board number these repos feed, e.g. 11. Leave empty to skip all board steps.

board_owner.title: Project owner
board_owner.description: The org or user that owns the board. May differ from the repo owner.

status_in_progress.title: "In progress" status name
status_in_progress.description: The Status field value to set when work starts.

ready_label.title: Autopilot label
ready_label.description: Label marking an issue as safe for unattended work.
